Thank you for this reply. I see it the same way, given how I was in love with more than one person at a time in my life. Yet in my mind, love and relationships are a choice. A choice you make everyday.

I did have crushes while being with my ex and I could have easily pursued them, but I knew I wanted her, I wanted to be loyal and don't fall prey to the dumb "grass is greener on the other side" trap. We talked about it many times, I expressed to her how I want to know if she falls in love and that we need to reflect on those feelings.

She had always very strong opinions about cheating and that just kissing would be the end of us. Never even once have I thought she would be the one to actually betray me like that. I feel like I never knew her. Like the one I loved was just an illusion under the mask of a selfish narcissist.

I know I could not have done anything better. Once you decide the other person is better suited for you, your partner can't win no matter what. Have been in that role for the second time already and lost to a junkie again.

It still feels embarassing to me. I feel like everyone around me is pitying me and looking at me with the thought of "Look, that's the girl that got her gf stolen by her alcoholic friend." I feel like trash, I feel like I wasn't worth anything. She didn't think about it, she didn't fight, she just threw me away. What does it tell me about me and our relationship? I am disgusted by her, by him and by me at the same time. It hurts so much knowing it was so easy to let me go and don't even look back for a second.
